name: ach
description: ACH (Agent Capability Hub) plugins: using the platform from ach-cli, writing its GitOps objects, installing it.

plugins.name: ach-cli
plugins.description: Use this organization's AI platform (ACH) from the command line: sign in, find and hydrate Environments into Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI or pi, MCP sign-in, environment keys (ek-) and ach-cli local.

plugins.name: ach-gitops
plugins.description: Write and maintain ACH custom resources in a GitOps repo: Environments, plugin and skill marketplaces, Plugins, Skills, Prompts, Artifacts, BackendIdentityPolicies and LiteLLMConnections, and debug their status.

plugins.name: ach-install
plugins.description: Install, configure and upgrade ACH on Kubernetes with its Helm chart: prerequisites (Postgres, Valkey, Dex, LiteLLM), values, sign-in, topology, Enterprise features and post-install checks.
